events.text: A street barber gives you a haircut so bad that a child points and laughs.

choices.text: Wear a hat for a month

effects.log: The hat becomes your trademark. Nobody remembers the haircut.
Somehow, it becomes fashionable. Half the young swordsmen copy it.

events.text: A debt collector knocks on your door by mistake. He is looking for someone with a similar name.

choices.text: Help him find the right person

effects.log: He is so grateful he forgets to be frightening.

choices.text: Pretend to be that person and scare him off

effects.log: He flees. The real debtor sends you a cake.

events.text: Your roof leaks in the rainy season. The bucket under it fills every hour.

effects.log: Two days on the roof with scavenged tiles. It holds. Mostly.
Done properly in a day. (−8 taels)

events.text: You find a purse in the road with forty taels and a letter to someone's mother.

effects.log: A young soldier on leave. He cries. He tells everyone about you.
Forty taels. You never read the letter. You think about it anyway.

events.text: You wake in an inn room that is not yours. The owner of the room is standing in the doorway holding a very large cleaver.

ok.log: It was the wrong key. You both laugh, eventually.

fail.log: The cleaver comes out. You leave by the window.

effects.log: Efficient. Undignified. Effective.

events.text: You decide to learn to cook properly. The first attempt fills the house with smoke.

effects.log: By autumn you can cook three dishes. The neighbours stop fleeing.
You eat at the noodle stall every night. The noodle seller becomes your friend.

events.text: Your new neighbour practises the gong at dawn every day.

ok.log: He moves his practice to noon. He was lonely; now he visits.

fail.log: He plays louder. War is declared.

choices.text: Practise your own shouting technique at the same time

effects.log: The whole street wakes. The gong stops.

events.text: A friend gives you a gift: an expensive sword. It is very clearly a sword for a much taller person.

effects.log: You hang it on the wall. Every time they visit, they beam at it.

choices.text: Trade it for one that fits

effects.log: The smith exchanges it. Your friend never knows. Probably.

events.text: A market seller asks triple the price for a fish. It is the principle of the thing.

ok.log: Half price and a free fish head. You won.

fail.log: He wins. You pay triple and feel like a fool.

effects.log: Some battles are not worth fighting. This was one.

events.text: An old friend from your village turns up at your door after twenty years.

effects.log: You remember everything and nothing is the same. It is wonderful.

choices.text: Show them how far you have come

effects.log: They are impressed. And a little sad, you think.

events.text: Two customers argue at the bathhouse over a towel. One of them is you.

effects.log: You dry off with your robe. Dignity intact, robe wet.

fail.log: You slip on the tiles. The whole bathhouse cheers.

events.text: A cough goes around the town. It finds you too.

effects.log: A week in bed. You recover completely.
The cough lasts two months and follows you everywhere.

events.text: You borrowed a book five years ago and never returned it. The owner is now a sect elder.

effects.log: The elder laughs and gives you another one.
It becomes a guilty weight on your shelf.

events.text: A boy sells matches in the cold. His hands are purple.

effects.log: You have matches for three years. He has a warm winter.
Your hands freeze on the walk home. It is fine.

events.text: A drunk poet in the tavern writes a poem about your nose.

effects.log: He writes another about your eyes. Better.
He is furious, then impressed. You become drinking friends.

events.text: The tax collector says you owe three years of back taxes on a house you never owned.

ok.log: The records show the right owner. The collector apologises, barely.

fail.log: You pay to make it go away.

choices.text: Pay to make it go away

effects.log: Unfair, efficient. (−15 taels)

events.text: A matchmaker has decided you are her next project and will not leave.

effects.log: It is a disaster in the most charming way.

choices.text: Tell her you are married to the sword

effects.log: She writes it down and returns with a list of swordswomen and swordsmen.

events.text: A stranger collapses in front of your door in the heat.

effects.log: Water, shade, a day of rest. He turns out to be a travelling merchant with a long memory.
The physician comes. The stranger lives.

events.text: You catch a hand in your sleeve: a pickpocket, very young, very startled.

choices.text: Let him go with a coin

effects.log: He stares, takes it, runs. Maybe he remembers.
Justice. The boy cries the whole way.

events.text: A quiet day fishing on the river. Nothing bites.

effects.log: Still nothing. The quiet is the catch.
The fish flee in terror. You are very refreshed.

events.text: A travelling painter offers to paint your portrait for five taels.

effects.log: It looks nothing like you and exactly like how you feel.
Your painting is terrible. He buys it for a copper, laughing.

events.text: Your roommate at the inn snores like a mountain falling.

effects.log: A strange new focus technique: "snore endurance".
The horse is quieter. Barely.

events.text: The village well rope snaps. The bucket and a child's shoe are at the bottom.

ok.log: Bucket and shoe retrieved. The child cheers.

fail.log: You get stuck halfway. The village pulls you up with the new rope.

effects.log: Everyone brings a piece. The rope is a patchwork. It holds for years.

events.text: A retired master in the market plays chess with anyone for a copper. He never loses.

ok.log: A draw! The whole market gathers. He shakes your hand.

fail.log: He wins in twenty moves and gives you your copper back.

effects.log: You learn his openings. Next year, maybe.

events.text: You accidentally walk into a stranger's wedding banquet and are immediately given a seat.

effects.log: Nobody asks who you are. The best dinner of the year.
Probably wise. You take a dumpling for the road.

events.text: Night falls on a mountain pass. Wolves are howling, and your fire is small.

choices.text: Keep the fire high all night

effects.log: No sleep, no wolves.

ok.log: You sleep. The wolves pass beneath you.

fail.log: You fall asleep and nearly fall out.

events.text: The inn catches fire at midnight. You smell smoke before anyone else.

effects.log: You pound on every door. Not one guest is lost.
You make it out. Others do too, mostly.

events.text: The rope bridge you are crossing snaps a strand. It sags beneath you.

ok.log: You make it as the bridge falls behind you.

fail.log: It drops. You cling to the cliff and climb up, torn and shaking.

effects.log: Slow, careful, alive. You find another way.

events.text: The well at a roadside village tastes strange. The villagers have been sick for a week.

ok.log: A dead animal in the source. You clear it. The village recovers.

fail.log: You get sick too, but you warn them.

effects.log: They thank you and dig a new well.

events.text: A rockfall blocks the mountain road. A cart is trapped with a family inside.

ok.log: Rock by rock. The family is out by sunset.

fail.log: You free them, and crush your hand doing it.

effects.log: You run to the village. The rescue takes all night. Everyone survives.

events.text: Fog in the mountains. You have been walking in circles for a day.

choices.text: Find your way by the stars

ok.log: The fog clears at night. You find north and walk out by dawn.

fail.log: Two more days lost. You come out thin and very humble.

effects.log: Streams lead to people. You arrive at a village by nightfall.

events.text: The river is swollen. The ferry has stopped. You need to be on the other side by morning.

fail.log: The current drags you a li downstream. You climb out, alive.

effects.log: You arrive late. Some things can wait.

events.text: Three bandits step out of the trees. Their swords are rusty and their faces are hungry.

fail.log: They take your purse and leave you bruised.

effects.log: Hungry bandits are just hungry. They eat and walk away.

events.text: Walking in the summer heat, the world begins to spin.

effects.log: An hour under a tree and plenty of water. You recover.
You collapse at the next village. A kind family nurses you.

events.text: A mad dog charges at children in the square.

ok.log: You drive it off with a stick. The children are safe.

fail.log: It bites your arm before you drive it away.

effects.log: Every child safe behind a door.

events.text: Crossing a frozen lake, the ice cracks under you.

ok.log: You reach the shore, soaked to the knee.

fail.log: You fall through. You pull yourself out, frozen.

effects.log: The ice breaks behind every step. You make it.

events.text: A friendly spar goes wrong. Your partner's blade slips and cuts deep.

effects.log: A month of stiffness. Your partner visits every day, guilty.

choices.text: Laugh it off and keep training

effects.log: The wound heals slowly. Your partner learns to be careful.

events.text: A snake has found its way into your bedding.

ok.log: Out the window, both of you calm.

fail.log: It bites. You spend a week with a swollen hand.

effects.log: Two hours awake, staring at a snake. It leaves at dawn.

events.text: The inn's stew tastes a little too interesting.

effects.log: Wise. You are merely hungry.
Three days of regret.

variants: The dumplings at the roadside stall have a sourness that was not in the recipe.
The fish in the inn's soup has been dead for longer than the cook is admitting.

events.text: A landslide buries half a village after days of rain.

ok.log: You pull out two children and an old man. The village never forgets.

fail.log: You dig until your hands bleed. Some are saved.

effects.log: Everyone digs in the right place. More are saved.
